newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday, issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates moved in a narrow range today and that the trend was likely to continue in the short term.

"It seems falls in late August have been checked since the start of this month despite continued lending from state-run banks," one trader said. "Negative effects of the bank interest rate cut by the central bank in August have been digested."
But traders said in the long run, the rates were likely to go down again due to China's falling inflation, which would prompt the central bank to consider more bank rate cuts.
